package.name: comma_camera
package.description: ROS 2 camera driver for comma devices. Reads the ISP output of openpilot's camerad (Qualcomm Spectra ISP driver for the OX03C10 / OS04C10 sensors) zero-copy over VisionIPC and publishes sensor_msgs/Image, CompressedImage (JPEG) and CameraInfo for the road, wide-road and driver cameras.
